conclusions: B实际由快层反馈触发1次，其中1次旧参考尚未判受阻；新增触发链确实被用到。
首次获准绕行反馈发送→重规划触发：A 2.639秒，B 0.059秒。
首次规划请求→新参考有效控制：A 0.643秒，B 3.181秒；这段时间不含此前感知和触发等待。
从首次获准介入后的反馈发送算到真正有效新控制：A 3.541秒，B 3.340秒，本次只缩短0.202秒。
B提前开始规划，但首次候选在最新动态验收被拒，随后重试才交付；不能把提前触发直接当成提前交付已解决。
同一候选和最新CV下，发布时重新对应候选相位，把该碰撞点检查时刻推后约0.445秒，间隙从+5.59厘米变为−1.44厘米；这个时序差足以解释该点拒绝，不是预算或轮约束拒绝。
A：原重规划触发：到达目标，未发现物理球采样接触。
B：增加快层绕行反馈：到达目标，未发现物理球采样接触。
本轮只检验快层已经介入后能否及时通知慢层；异步A/B输入可能不同，不能据最终成败单独证明因果或双时间尺度优化已完成。

clock_shift.scope: At this exact unchanged candidate configuration, old/latest CV at the original clock both have positive gaps. With latest source fixed, changing to the actual latest phase clock produces the recorded collision. Old source at the new time is outside its valid 3 s horizon and is not extrapolated.

collision_pair.scope: Recorded native sphere hard-check boundary, not physical mesh contact or actual robot execution.

frozen_feedback_input.semantics: frozen checked MPPI prediction; soft spatial targets, not committed future states

coordination_evidence.semantics: The frozen handoff target is a soft spatial position/heading/velocity match among first three native pieces, execution weight 0 and handoff weight 1; it does not commit MPPI motion, enforce the same passing side, or require a fixed-time rendezvous.

facts: Native planning accepted this candidate on frozen source and original candidate clock. Latest gate used the same polynomial and a later current-pose-associated nominal clock.
Measured robot pose itself passed the latest predicted obstacle check. No position/yaw residual threshold rejected this request.

At the actual rejected candidate sample, swapping only the CV source at the original clock keeps positive clearance; shifting the clock while holding the latest CV source fixed yields negative clearance.
The latest collision is a genuine model-boundary overlap between base check sphere 15 and latest predicted point 3.
Candidate heads toward negative y while actual MPPI and its frozen soft target head positive y; that coordination mismatch is real, but is not a residual-based hard rejection.
limits: This single-point comparison isolates sufficient cause of this rejection, not the only cause of every earlier candidate failure.
Frozen source queried at the latest phase clock lies beyond its valid 3 s window; no safety gap is invented there.
The 0.445 s shift must not be read as a proven physical delay or prediction error of the actual MPPI trajectory; it is the difference between the two candidate test schedules.
The candidate was not published or executed, so model collision is not an actual collision.
Changing the clock or deleting the latest check to force acceptance is not validated by these records.
